title: SseEvent::StateChange carries raw HashMap while push::StateChange is a struct — no unification
description: Round 3 introduced push::StateChange as the canonical WS type, but sse.rs SseEvent::StateChange is still an inline struct variant {changed: HashMap}. Extension crates handling both SSE and WS push must write duplicate destructuring code for what is conceptually the same event. The half-completed consolidation means push::StateChange is imported by ws/ but SseEvent in sse.rs has its own parallel representation with no From/Into bridge. Fix: change SseEvent::StateChange to be a tuple variant wrapping push::StateChange.
